text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka has suffered an injury, so
I've
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sorry for causing so much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The worst of the pain is gone. I
think I'll be
fine with some rest.
choice_data_list_en: Are you sure you should be awake?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If I had only been more careful...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If I had only been more careful...
choice_data_list: 今はゆっくり休むんだ
早く治してトレーニングしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Take it easy and rest for now.
Take it easy and get some rest for now.
Let's get you healed up fast and start training!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But my poor legs will be so
bored...
choice_data_list: 今はゆっくり休むんだ
早く治してトレーニングしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Take it easy and rest for now.
Take it easy and get some rest for now.
Let's get you healed up fast and start training!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I already miss the feeling of the turf under my feet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I have a proposition. I've heard that
light
exercise is useful for recovery.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I could do a little light
jogging to
help my rehabilitation?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll be careful. I'll make sure to go slow.
choice_data_list_en: As long as you don't push yourself too hard!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sigh... There's still a while to go before I'm feeling 100%.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By attempting to jog while undergoing

rehabilitation, Silence Suzuka has
disrupted her
recovery process,
lengthening the necessary
treatment
period.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm starting to feel a lot better.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I might be able to return to my training
soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that jogging has helped to
speed up
Silence Suzuka's recovery.
